content.short: Guild is an automated community creation and management tool.
content.description: Guild helps community builders grow and manage Web3 DAOs at scale through automation. It strengthens gating and security with a robust API and SDK infrastructure, simplifying member onboarding, role automation, and rule enforcement across diverse communities. By providing programmable controls and clear governance tooling, Guild supports the daily operations of powerful DAOs and accelerates community-wide initiatives. Notable protocols, including Rabbithole and Lens Protocol, have built their DAOs with Guild.
